create_MarkdownDocumentBackend: create a MarkdownDocumentBackend instance from a markdown file or BytesIO stream to parse markdown content
convert_MarkdownDocumentBackend: convert a MarkdownDocumentBackend into a DoclingDocument by parsing the markdown AST and building structured doc items
test_MarkdownDocumentBackend_is_valid: test whether a MarkdownDocumentBackend successfully initialized from its source file or stream
build_MarkdownDocumentBackend_table: build table structures from markdown pipe-syntax rows into DoclingDocument TableData with row and column cells
iterate_MarkdownDocumentBackend_elements: iterate a marko markdown AST and convert headings, lists, images, code blocks, and HTML blocks into DoclingDocument nodes
